OK, ben écoute, modifie le skill en conséquence. C'est parti.

Et installe le évidemment!!!
requirements: Persistent program budget survives new chats and processes
Evaluation decisions stay separate from execution states
External unavailability becomes terminal WAIT_EXTERNAL without polling
Build and candidate checkpointing remain separate from signed promotion
Resume v19 certification and public benchmark after the correction
Install only the deterministically certified candidate and verify the installed copy
